messages.subject: GRCm38 Mbp location to cM
parts:
Hi Karl,

The genotyping array we used gives us only the Mbp location for all the SNPs. I know qtl2 utilizes cM to calculate the genotype probabilities. What else does qtl2 utilize the genetic location for?

In addition, I am going back and redoing the analysis for the purpose of more complete documentation. When I convert my Mbp locations to cM, which cM build should I use? Cox or G2F1?

Thanks!

Sincerely,
Avni

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] GRCm38 Mbp location to cM

On 06/21/2018 06:35 PM, Avni Gupta wrote:
> Hi Karl,
>
> The genotyping array we used gives us only the Mbp location for all
> the SNPs. I know qtl2 utilizes cM to calculate the genotype
> probabilities. What else does qtl2 utilize the genetic location for?
>

That's the key use. You might also want to plot LOD curves with respect
to genetic distance.

> In addition, I am going back and redoing the analysis for the purpose
> of more complete documentation. When I convert my Mbp locations to cM,
> which cM build should I use? Cox or G2F1?
>
>

That's entirely up to you. I think the G2F1 map has more complete
coverage and is more precise, so that may be preferable, but I don't
have a strong opinion on this.

karl
